message.content: This README intro is bloated, cut it down: "It is worth noting that, basically, this library is a small wrapper that, in order to make HTTP retries easier, gives you a retry() helper. As previously mentioned, retry() retries idempotent requests up to 3 times."

content.text: I'll do it by hand. My procedure: 1) split the paragraph into sentences, 2) strike filler ("it is worth noting", "basically", "in order to", "as previously mentioned"), 3) merge sentences that restate each other, 4) re-read for any lost qualifier. Result: "This library is a small wrapper with a retry() helper that retries idempotent requests up to 3 times."
